description: Recompute the confidence, health and completeness scores of one of the user's listings from its current record — the dashboard's "Re-align scores". Requires the user's confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: you get an action_summary and a token instead of the action. After the user explicitly confirms that summary, call again with the SAME arguments plus this token.

listing.description: One of the user's own listings.

name: refresh_listing_scores
title: Refresh my listing's scores
